title: 第779章 巫神殿末日第778章 楚王临南荒
slug: 打造万古家族开局奖励极道帝兵
lines: 苍穹之上，血雨滂沱。
七位巫神殿先辈祭司极尽升华，终究只是飞蛾扑火。
他们实在是太老了，即使极尽升华，力量也维持不了太久。
仅抵挡了一炷香的时间。
七位先辈祭司便在十四位神府围攻下，身死道消。
七具枯槁的残躯，连同他们最后的执念，彻底消散在了这天地间。
南都。
巫神殿。
虚空突然裂开了一道缝。
第二祭司披头散发的从虚空裂缝中冲出。
她落在主殿前的玉阶上。
大口大口的喘着粗气。
突然。
一道惊雷撕裂苍穹。
血雨滂沱。
第二祭司猛地抬起头。
任由血雨冲洒在她的脸上。
神府陨落，天地同悲。
倾盆血雨，染红了南都的每一寸土地。
第二祭司瘫跪在玉阶上。
浑身颤抖，心如死灰。
死了。
七位先辈祭司，七尊神府境大能。
巫神殿的底蕴，就这么没了。
“不行......巫神殿绝不能亡在我的手中！”
她连滚带爬的从玉阶上站起，拖着残破不堪的身躯，跌跌撞撞的向着巫神殿后山而去。
那是整个南荒的绝对禁地。
更是大祭司的闭关之所。
巫神殿后山。
一座幽暗深邃的山洞嵌在绝壁之上。
洞口四周。
爬满了密密麻麻，形态各异，色彩斑斓的蛊虫。
其中一些蛊虫，便是神府境修士看了都头皮发麻。
此刻，这些蛊虫嗅到第二祭司身上的血腥味，纷纷躁动起来，发出刺耳的嘶鸣。
第二祭司无视了这些虎视眈眈的蛊虫。
正欲开口。
突然。
她好像察觉到了什么。
content_en:
Above the sky, blood rained heavily.
The seven ancestor priests of the Witch Temple have made great achievements, but in the end they are just moths flying into the flame.
They are really too old, and even if they are extremely sublimated, their power will not last long.
It only lasted for a stick of incense.
The seven ancestor priests died under the siege of fourteen gods.
The seven withered remains, together with their last obsession, completely dissipated in the world.
...
Nandu.
Witch Temple.
A crack suddenly opened in the void.
The second priest rushed out of the crack in the void with disheveled hair.
She landed on the jade steps in front of the main hall.
Breathing heavily.
Sudden.
A thunder ripped through the sky.
The blood rained heavily.
The second priest suddenly raised his head.
Let the blood rain on her face.
The palace of God falls, and the world and the earth are sad together.
The downpour of blood dyed every inch of Nandu red.
The second priest collapsed and knelt on the jade steps.
His whole body was shaking and his heart was as gray as ashes.
dead.
Seven ancestor priests, seven powerful men in the divine realm.
The foundation of the Witch Temple is just gone.
"No... The Witch Temple must not die in my hands!"
She climbed up from the jade steps, dragging her broken body, stumbling towards the back hill of the Witch Temple.
That is an absolutely forbidden area in the entire Southern Wilderness.
It is also the retreat place of the high priest.
The mountain behind the Witch Temple.
A dark and deep cave is embedded in the cliff.
Around the cave entrance.
It was crawling with densely packed Gu insects of different shapes and colors.
Some of these Gu worms make even the monks in the Divine Mansion realm feel numb when they look at them.
At this moment, these Gu insects smelled the smell of blood on the second priest's body, and they became restless and made harsh hissing sounds.
The second priest ignored these eager Gu insects.
Just about to speak.
Sudden.
She seemed to notice something.
